narrative.synopsis: Apollo, Pandora are involved in III. The city of Delphi, containing the famous oracle of Apollo, was built on the slopes of Mount Parnassus in Phocis. When a goatherd ventured near the spot, he found a peculiar vapor arising from the cavern, and as he inhaled it, he was affected in the same way as the animals had been.
